stats.label: Maximum stay in Ireland under the waiver

diaspora_bullets: Enter the UK first - Ireland-first trips are not covered
UK long-term residents still need an Irish visa
news_summary: Ireland has extended its Short-Stay Visa Waiver Programme to December 31, 2026, allowing eligible Indian passport holders with a qualifying UK short-stay visa to visit Ireland without a separate Irish visa.
payoff: No extension beyond December 31, 2026 has been announced.
